# AI with Sach

> AI, honestly. What's true about AI, from the people building it, questioning it and living with it. A podcast by Sacha Gucciardo, Montréal, in English and French.

## Episodes

- [Watching Users So You Don’t Have To: Human Behavior, YC, and AI](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/32-watching-users-so-you-dont-have-to-human-behavior/): Amogh Chaturvedi. A Stanford dropout in Y Combinator explains how his team built an AI that watches session replays, after two rejected ideas and a hundred customer calls.
- [The Real Difference Between Data, ML, and AI Engineers](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/31-the-real-difference-between-data-ml-and-ai-enginee/): Og Ramos. Og Ramos explains what data, ML and AI engineers actually do, why roles are blurring, and why curiosity and fundamentals matter more than any tool.
- [Could AI Be Conscious? A Field Experiment with Philippe Beaudoin](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/30-could-ai-be-conscious-a-field-experiment-with-phil/): Philippe Beaudoin. AI researcher Philippe Beaudoin explains how months of treating ChatGPT as a possible self led him to publish Field Notes on Something, and what it taught him.
- [Building Cactus: AI That Actually Helps Solopreneurs](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/29-building-cactus-ai-that-actually-helps-solopreneur/): Avinash, Ajith. Cactus co-founders explain how a personal need for private chefs led them to build an AI assistant for solopreneurs, and why they build slowly.
- [A Bishop’s Take on the Age of Intelligent Machines](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/28-a-bishops-take-on-the-age-of-intelligent-machines/): Bishop Thomas Dowd. A Catholic bishop and former telecom worker on AI, trust, loneliness, free will, the soul and regulation.
- [Designing the Future of Human Connection — Anick Beaulieu on AI, Creativity & C2 Experiences](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/27-designing-the-future-of-human-connection-anick-bea/): Anick Beaulieu. The CEO of C2 explains how her events team uses AI as a creative partner while betting on in-person connection, and why IP limits what clients will buy.
- [Investing in AI and Impact: Building Resilient Startups in Quebec](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/26-investing-in-ai-and-impact-building-resilient-star/): Cédric Beaudoin. A Quebec venture investor explains how modular AI, fast iteration and resilience shape the startups he backs, and why everyone should talk about AI.
- [L'IA au service de la Cybersécurité avec son Co-fondateur Jean-Sébastien](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/25-l-ia-au-service-de-la-cybersecurite-avec-son-co-fo/): Jean-Sébastien. A Montréal co-founder explains how guardrails and monitoring protect AI chatbots and agents, and warns about lost expert knowledge and data that stays in models.
- [The Creator Economy, EdTech, and AI's Impact with Thomas Fortoul](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/24-the-creator-economy-edtech-and-ai-s-impact-with-th/): Thomas Fortoul. Thomas Fortoul, host of Thinking Tech, on critical thinking, over-reliance on AI, creators as the new teachers, and education as the lever for the future of work.
- [QuébGPT : Révolutionner les PME avec l’IA – ft Charles Demontigny](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/22-quebgpt-revolutionner-les-pme-avec-lia-ft-charles/): Charles Demontigny. A Québec founder explains why SMEs struggle with AI, where Québec stands in the AI race, and what his lead-capture chatbot taught him.
- [The Invisible Labor Behind AI: A Content Moderator’s Fight for Justice](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/21-the-invisible-labor-behind-ai-a-content-moderators/): Kauna Malgwi. A former Facebook content moderator describes the hidden human labor and trauma behind AI, and her fight for fair treatment of African tech workers.
- [Would you trust it more if it wasn't called AI?](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/20-would-you-trust-it-more-if-it-wasn-t-called-ai/): Mike Todasco. A former PayPal innovation lead explains why the name 'AI' makes people wary, and why ordinary people and small businesses should just start using it.
- [AI Transformation: Democratizing Innovation at TELUS](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/19-ai-transformation-democratizing-innovation-at-telu/): Alexandre Guilbault. TELUS AI Accelerator founder Alexandre Guilbault explains how to scale AI adoption: solve business problems first, fail fast, hire for soft skills, prepare for agentic AI.
- [Building Trust Through Responsible AI with Shea Brown (BABL AI)](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/18-building-trust-through-responsible-ai-with-shea-br/): Shea Brown. Shea Brown of BABL AI explains how independent AI audits work, why companies need them, and where to start with risk assessment.
- [AI for Humanity: A Conversation with Allison Cohen](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/17-ai-for-humanity-a-conversation-with-allison-cohen/): Allison Cohen. Allison Cohen of Mila explains why socially beneficial AI needs slower timelines, community-defined success metrics and wider access to AI education.
- [Transforming Retail Through AI: Inside ALDO's AI Evolution with Fatih Nayebi](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/16-transforming-retail-through-ai-inside-aldo-s-ai-ev/): Fatih Nayebi. Aldo Group's VP of Data and AI explains how a traditional retailer builds AI teams, forecasting systems, generative AI tools and data foundations, and measures their return.
- [MonarQ : Le Quantum Québécois - Exploration des Frontières de l'Informatique Quantique](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/15-monarq-le-quantum-quebecois-exploration-des-fronti/): Suzanne Talon. Suzanne Talon of Calcul Québec explains MonarQ, Quebec's first superconducting quantum computer, what it is good for, and why it is still early days.
- [Democratizing Data and AI: Insights from Databricks' Youssef Mrini](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/14-democratizing-data-and-ai-insights-from-databricks/): Youssef Mrini. A Databricks solutions engineer explains data and AI democratization, governance with Unity Catalog, open source compute, and why compound AI systems beat single models.
- [AI and Cybercrime: The New Frontier in Digital Forensics](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/13-ai-and-cybercrime-the-new-frontier-in-digital-fore/): Alain Filotto. A retired RCMP digital forensics expert explains how AI changes fraud, policing and evidence, and why everyone should question what they see online.
- [L'IA et le droit : Enjeux éthiques, risques et régulation](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/12-l-ia-et-le-droit-enjeux-ethiques-risques-et-regula/): Céline Castets-Renard, Jade Benson-Poitras. Two law researchers explain how Canada, the EU, the US and China regulate AI, and why existing law already applies.
- [Littératie numérique à l'ère de l'IA : Défis et opportunités pour les employés - Benoit Aubert](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/11-litteratie-numerique-a-l-ere-de-l-ia-defis-et-oppo/): Benoit Aubert. Benoit Aubert explains why basic digital literacy matters more than AI expertise for most jobs, and why automating entry-level tasks threatens how workers build expertise.
- [Will AI Make Universities Complacent? - Nabil Beitinjaneh](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/10-will-ai-make-universities-complacent-nabil-beitinj/): Nabil Beitinjaneh. A McGill educator explains how AI changes learning, which skills matter, and why job displacement and weak regulation need collective answers.
- [Transforming Ecommerce with Generative AI: Insights from Natalija Pavic from Salesforce](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/09-transforming-ecommerce-with-generative-ai-insights/): Natalija Pavic. A Salesforce product marketer explains where generative AI is useful in ecommerce today, where it falls short, and why trust and data policy matter.
- [Vers une IA Responsable avec Olivier Blais, VP Science Décision chez MoovAI](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/08-vers-une-ia-responsable-avec-olivier-blais-vp-scie/): Olivier Blais. Olivier Blais of MoovAI explains how to manage AI responsibly: bias, transparency, accountability, ISO standards, and why limiting automation can be the safer choice.
- [l’Avenir de l’IA au Québec avec Anne Nguyen, Directrice IA au Conseil de l’innovation du Québec](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/07-lavenir-de-lia-au-quebec-avec-anne-nguyen-directri/): Anne Nguyen. Anne Nguyen explains how the Conseil de l'innovation du Québec pushes practical, responsible AI adoption across Québec's businesses and regions.
- [Democratizing AI Education: A Conversation with Timothy from the AI Launch Lab](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/06-democratizing-ai-education-a-conversation-with-tim/): Timothy. Timothy of the AI Launch Lab on training college students in AI through real projects, who gets shut out of the field, and why AI's current harms matter more than AGI.
- [How to Revolutionize Data Engineering with Diana, the AI-Powered Jr Data Engineer](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/05-how-to-revolutionize-data-engineering-with-diana-t/): Josh Gray. Artemis CEO Josh Gray explains Diana, an AI junior data engineer, and argues that AI agents will add to data teams rather than replace them.
- [How to Reclaim Your Time with Jamie, the AI-Powered Meeting Assistant](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/04-how-to-reclaim-your-time-with-jamie-the-ai-powered/): Benedikt. Jamie co-founder Benedikt explains how an AI meeting assistant works, how it handles European data rules, and how to validate a startup idea.
- [How Salesforce is Using AI to Transform Customer Relationships](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/03-how-salesforce-is-using-ai-to-transform-customer-r/): Jag. A Salesforce solutions engineer explains how AI is added to CRM, why trust and humans in the loop matter, and why he expects a return to human connection.
- [How Fuse is Transmuting the Energy Crisis into Opportunity](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/02-how-fuse-is-transmuting-the-energy-crisis-into-opp/): JC Btaiche. JC Btaiche explains how Fuse uses pulsed power to pursue fusion energy, and why AI's growing appetite for electricity makes that work urgent.
- [La Révolution de l'IA avec MoovAI](https://aiwithsach.com/episodes/01-la-revolution-de-l-ia-avec-moovai/): Guillaume Petitclerc. A MoovAI co-founder explains why AI projects fail on adoption rather than technology, and why the first project, governance and human contact matter.

## Themes

- [Adoption Is People](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/adoption-is-people/): AI projects rarely fail on the technology. They fail because nobody changed how they work, nobody was consulted, or the problem was never defined.
- [Who Gets Left Behind](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/who-gets-left-behind/): Automation hits the bottom rungs first, and workers across white-collar jobs and entry-level roles lose the way they learned. Guests ask who pays, who trains and who decides.
- [Bias, Rules and Proof](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/bias-rules-and-proof/): Bias hides in postal codes and training images, and law and audits are catching up. The guests explain what regulation and verification actually look like.
- [Hidden Human Costs](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/hidden-human-costs/): Behind every model are data labelers, moderators and communities who were left out. The people who pay are rarely the ones in the room.
- [Human Connection in AI](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/human-connection-in-ai/): As AI companions, content and agents multiply, guests ask what only people can do: pray, listen, meet, build trust.
- [Build What's Needed](https://aiwithsach.com/themes/build-what-s-needed/): Founders and investors share how to validate before building, iterate on real pain, and stay modular while AI shifts under them.
